details: Company Name: Tata Consultancy Services

considering the various factors.

projects.name: Exception Processing System
details: Company Name: Wells Fargo
EPS was introduced to handle the exception based introduced due to the
distributed capture process in the cheque processing system. This
application allows the monitoring control and balancing of the outstanding
exception and gives the ability to find out the actual paper which is
stored throughout the enterprise. One can also create the manual
adjustments and local printing of the advice notices.

details: Company Name: Wells Fargo
eTran is a web-based application that is designed to replace the paper
tickets for the internally generated transactions. It uses the same data as
on the paper and posts the validated transactions to GL, Hogan, Recon Plus
and Branch Settlement Systems.
Responsibilities:
1) Involve in requirement gathering and analysis of existing system.
2) Worked on Spring boot version migration and enhancement.

entry.text: Project Name: Electronic Transactions
Company Name: Wells Fargo
eTran is a web-based application that is designed to replace the paper
tickets for the internally generated transactions. It uses the same data as
on the paper and posts the validated transactions to GL, Hogan, Recon Plus
and Branch Settlement Systems.
Responsibilities:
1) Involve in requirement gathering and analysis of existing system.
2) Worked on Spring boot version migration and enhancement.
3) Worked on writing the junit test cases
4) Implemented holiday feature in the system
5) Involved in work related to bug fixe ad defect resolving.
6) Worked on computation part to handle the correct route and the path.
7) Worked on server-side input validation
8) Worked on to do the full and delta load and validate the data.
9) Worked on to add new country and tenant in the system.
10) Handling and managing the sprint planning by following the agile
methodologies.
11) Struts to spring MVC migration of eTrans application.
12) Converted eTran application build from Ant to Gradle.
13) Configure Apache configuration with Spring MVC
14) Involved in creating a reporting tool for transaction data. [User can
get the transaction data and view it right there in the UI or can
export it to excel or CSV file]
15) Involved in Store the transaction history for 365 days. Store the data
based on the sources from the table on hourly basis.
16) Worked Redis memory where saved data stored in multiple regions
17) Automated the mechanism to identify the incorrect and unconsolidated
batches yet to send to downstream
18) Worked on Connect:Direct to NDM the file to Windows and Linux
machines.
19) Worked on to save data in Google clould storage and BT.
Academic Credentials
Master of Computer Applications
Oriental College of Management, Bhopal (RGTU, Bhopal) in 2010.
Bachelor of Computer Applications
P. G. College (BU, Bhopal) in 2006
